example: Example run with fictional figures: Northbrook Trading, September adjustments, Wednesday 30 September 2026. The figures match the worked examples on the step-by-step page.

messages.text: Can you build our September adjusting entries? I have three items.
Yes. Before I read anything, I need some answers. I ask them all at once, so the run does not stop again for each one.
list: Do you want me to use MosoFin, or will you upload the data?
What are the items? Please give the amounts and any documents.
Which company do the entries belong to?
Do they have a tax effect, and in which jurisdiction?
Above what amount do you want a review flag? I never pick one. Without one, I do not run that check.
Optional: what are the source documents, and should any entry reverse?
Through what date are the books closed, and did you report any later period?

messages.text: Use MosoFin. First, accrue the interim audit fieldwork: a $12,000 fee, 75% done. Second, move September's courier charges, $640, from Office Supplies to Freight-out. Third, August utilities look too high. Date them 30 September. Northbrook Trading, no tax effect. Flag anything over $25,000. The audit accrual reverses. Books are closed through 31 August, and August went to the bank.

messages.label: Found your workspace and company file

messages.text: I found one workspace, **Northbrook Trading**, with one company file of the same name. Is that the right one?

Here is my plan. I build **proposed entries** at **Northbrook Trading**, dated **Wed 30 Sep 2026**, against your chart, in **QuickBooks Online** import format. The audit accrual reverses on **Thu 1 Oct 2026**. No tax effect. Your review threshold is **$25,000**.
messages.after: For August utilities, I read account 2110 and the bills, and I show you what I find. Shall I start?

messages.label: Checked the tools, then read the books
messages.summary: 7 calls. Nothing in your books changed.

messages.text: The audit accrual is 75% of the $12,000 fee, which is **$9,000.00**. This is a **proposed entry, not posted**:
messages.after: No audit-fee accrual is open in 2110, and no bill from the auditor is in the books. So nothing is counted twice. I also propose the reversing entry, dated Thu 1 Oct 2026.

messages.text: Your second item stopped. **Freight-out is not in your chart.** I do not make an account or choose the nearest name. I found the three courier bills:
messages.after: Which account in your chart do you want for them?

messages.text: You are right about August utilities. They are in the books two times:

card.title: August utilities
rows: − The accrual that did not reverse

messages.after: The accrual did not reverse on 1 September. $2,040.00 is below your $25,000. Do you treat the error as immaterial?

messages.text: Use 6150 Shipping and Delivery. And yes, the utilities error is immaterial.
Here are the other two proposed entries. Each one balances to the penny:
messages.after: August is closed and reported, so the correction goes into September, and its memo names JE-202608-014. I do not change the August entry.

messages.text: I ran each of the 15 checks that applies to an entry, with its evidence. The others, such as a loan split, do not apply. Nothing has a flag:
messages.after: The open period rests on your date of 31 August, because your books show no lock date. A person posts these entries. I do not. Do you want them as an import file?

messages.text: Done. Here is **Northbrook Trading_JE_September adjustments_2026-09-30.xlsx**. It has the entries in QuickBooks Online import columns, headed "proposed entry, not posted", with a Validation Results sheet and a Coverage sheet.
messages.after: Do you want me to save your settings for next month?

messages.text: Done. For Northbrook Trading, I saved the account map, the import format, the numbering, the $25,000 threshold and the reversal policy. I never save amounts or entries, or your connection and tool settings.
